inspiration.title: Wason's 2-4-6 task
inspiration.note: The psychology task where you work out a hidden rule by proposing your own examples and being told whether each fits; Rule Finder makes that testing free, unlimited and the whole game.

inspiration.title: Eleusis
inspiration.note: A hidden-rule game about finding out by trying; Rule Finder borrows the idea of a rule you can only learn from what is accepted and what is refused.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules and fairness checks in the browser through WebAssembly (version 0.26.4, loaded from a CDN), so there is no server and no build step.
